headline: Montero advocates banning holiday rentals in the Canary Islands: "Tourism 'crushes' the lives of Canarians"
summary: Minister Montero advocated banning holiday rentals in the Canary Islands, arguing that tourism is crushing residents' lives. She cited Adeje, where 30% of homes are tourist homes.
why: Restrictions on short-term rentals affect tourism-dependent local economies, property owners and the holiday rental platforms operating there.
